name: Parallelized Accurate Sorting for Projected Tetrahedra
aliases: Quick and accurate sorting algorithm of tetrahedral datasets
definition: A view-dependent sorting algorithm for tetrahedral datasets that uses logical partitioning to enable parallel processing, solving the dependency and sequence limitations of neighboring tetrahedra in parallel performance.
summary: Parallelized Accurate Sorting for Projected Tetrahedra is a view-dependent algorithm that resolves parallelization bottlenecks by dividing datasets into spatial blocks and using logical partitioning to enable accurate, parallel sorting of unobstructed layers.
